write_coverage: Every emulated write is checked against the complete compared state objects or the emulated stack.
external_callbacks: No callbacks are simulated. Reaching error reporting or physical-memory dependency routines fails the case.
limitations: Differential equality can preserve original bugs; this is not an RSP architectural conformance test.
Only the selected vector handlers and reachable helpers are exercised, not the complete RSP dispatcher or host UI.
Invalid vector memory opcode 10 and vector-register-array overrun are excluded.
The standalone candidate may contain dependency stubs, but reaching the listed dependency functions is a test failure.
candidate_kind: VC7 /O2 /Ob1 /ML /GL /LTCG standalone RSP diagnostic DLL; linked dependency stubs are unreachable in every passing case.
coverage: All 16 multiply/accumulate opcodes across all 16 vector element modes, signed/unsigned 16-bit edge inputs and signed 48-bit accumulator boundaries.
Destination/source alias patterns, preserved accumulator storage bits, edge and seeded random vectors, full flags and guest-visible state.
All 32 combinations of the five VCL input flag bits in every lane; 896 VCL cases total.
Every supported vector load/store kind with all 16 element indexes, negative and positive displacement limits, 4 KiB wrap, and enabled/disabled/inhibited memory breakpoints.

recovered_regression.evidence: Original switch table 0x401620 maps kind 4 to 0x401290 and kind 6 to 0x401298: productShift=-16 in case 4 falls into the shared unsigned clamp bounds in case 6.
recovered_regression.source_fix: Restore case-4 fallthrough into case-6 clampMin=0 and clampMax=0xffff.

harness_rejection_checks: Calling original/rebuilt RSP_VADDB is rejected at ReportCPUError instead of executing a diagnostic stub.
An original vector load beyond the complete vector-register array is rejected by the emulated write-range guard.
vcl_reconstruction: Unsigned lane/flag-index types, promoted halfword operands and explicit carry/zero expressions; same 1472-byte original span and 562-byte matching prefix, still 712 normalized byte differences.
arithmetic_loop_reconstruction: VADD/VSUB/VSUT use unsigned lane indexes and explicit inner selector locals. All restore the original 20-byte frame and two-iteration/four-lane countdown, remain byte-unmatched at 539/538/542 normalized differences, and pass 384 behavior cases each.
